annotation.title_clean: ISO/IEC 25059:2023 Software engineering — Systems and software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) — Quality model for AI systems
annotation.title_en: ISO/IEC 25059:2023 Software engineering — Systems and software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) — Quality model for AI systems
annotation.summary_en: ISO store catalogue page for ISO/IEC 25059:2023, a voluntary international standard from JTC 1/SC 42 that defines a quality model for AI systems as an extension of SQuaRE. It provides consistent terminology for specifying, measuring and evaluating AI system quality. It is published and expected to be revised.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines a quality model for AI systems as an application-specific extension of the SQuaRE series.
Gives characteristics and sub-characteristics for specifying, measuring and evaluating AI system quality.
Allows stated quality requirements to be checked for completeness.
Published June 2023; stage 90.92 (to be revised), with ISO/IEC FDIS 25059 expected to replace it.
